title: Submodule quotient maps are open quotient maps
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, let $M$ be an $R$-module carrying a topology for which addition $M\times M\to M$ is continuous, and let $S\subseteq M$ be an $R$-submodule. Give $M/S$ the quotient topology (a subset is open iff its preimage in $M$ is open). Then the canonical map $q:M\to M/S$ is continuous, surjective and open; in particular it is a quotient map. This applies to finite-dimensional vector spaces over a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with their $\ell$-adic topology [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].

source.place: Corollary 6.8.5, proof, p. 60; the finite-dimensional topological linear algebra used in the sentence that the representation category admits kernels and cokernels.
